Leaderboard

Relative quality Elo from the pure-prompt artifact judge v2 (preview). Judge score is the mean overall verdict (0–1) across judged tasks. Telemetry columns are context, not score.

Task explorer

All tasks, colored by the judge's overall verdict where judged. Click a row for the key conflict, per-harness verdicts, flags, full answers and sources.

Every harness gets the identical task prompt and identical rules and runs against the live web in the same window. Ranking: pure-prompt artifact judge (variant C, tournament winner over 4 prompt variants), Claude Opus, two swap passes per task, NO web access and NO tools — it ranks the submitted evidence chains only. Pairwise verdicts → Bradley–Terry → Elo. Preview on 27/100 tasks.
